current.text: Projected starting five: Tyrese Haliburton, Andrew Nembhard, Aaron Nesmith, Pascal Siakam and Ivica Zubac.
If Kelly Oubre Jr. starts, he would replace Aaron Nesmith.
Projected bench rotation: Kelly Oubre Jr. as sixth man, then Obi Toppin, Jay Huff, T.J. McConnell and Jarace Walker.
Jay Huff is the backup center. Micah Potter is gone.
How Carlisle splits center minutes between Zubac and Huff is a big open question. There may be more experimenting at backup center than in past years.
Center depth behind Huff is weak: Larry Nance Jr. or Kobe Brown.
Lloyd expects Carlisle to manage Haliburton's minutes early in the season.
This lineup loses a lot of shooting but should be better on defense.
Being close to the first apron limited the team's offseason spending.
Indiana is expected to be a good team. Tony projects 47 to 48 wins. Josh projects 46 wins and a top-six seed in the East. Low risk of tanking.
The window with this core may only be one or two years.
Fantasy playoff schedule for our March 28 end is 3-4-3 games, with one back-to-back in each of weeks 20 and 21. That is not ideal.
Indiana has 15 back-to-backs, a middle-of-the-league count. With Carlisle's habit of resting players on back-to-backs, expect some missed games from the starters.

durable.text: Coach Rick Carlisle keeps regular-season minutes low, even for healthy players.
Carlisle limits his starting center's minutes and runs backup centers through the rotation, as he did with Myles Turner. Center minutes changed constantly last season.

tags.new_meaning: Team expected to make the playoffs and play to win all season, so tanking and late-season shutdowns are unlikely.

note: Indiana is expected to win, so tanking is not a worry. The problems are Carlisle's low minutes, his rest on back-to-backs and a weak 3-4-3 playoff schedule for our March 28 end. These hurt Zubac most, because Carlisle caps his starting centers. They also hurt Haliburton early, since his minutes are expected to be managed. Jay Huff gains as the backup center and handcuff. Early on, watch how the minutes split between Zubac and Huff, how fast Haliburton's minutes go up, and whether Oubre takes Nesmith's starting spot.
